objective: Test the two configuration concerns raised about the submitted ReLERNN comparison without rerunning unrelated manuscript experiments.

evaluation_data.reuse_rule: Every sensitivity arm uses byte-identical phased VCFs and exact truth maps from the frozen paired bottleneck benchmark.

software.runtime: The same pinned Betty B200-compatible image and Keras serialization compatibility patch as the frozen paired benchmark.

endpoints.primary: Pooled Pearson correlation after averaging the exact truth in each native ReLERNN output window.
secondary: Number of native windows and zero predictions

analysis_rules: Report all five existing and new arms.
Retain finite zero predictions as valid estimator outputs.
Do not change inputs, seeds, training sizes, epochs, phasing, mutation rate, or endpoints after viewing results.
Use Betty Slurm allocations for every simulation, training, prediction, and scoring stage.
